extracted.intended_audience: UMD faculty and researchers seeking funding opportunities
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for University of Maryland faculty and researchers on locating internal, limited-submission, and external sponsor funding opportunities and on coordinating equipment/instrumentation requests. Covers tools (InfoReady, SPINPlus), coordination practices, and where to get alerts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use InfoReady for internal program cycles and application details
rubrics_metrics.description: UMD offers recurring internal programs that support early-stage research, interdisciplinary collaboration, seed funding, and proposal development. Current cycles and application details are always available through InfoReady.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When pursuing internal UMD funding, consult InfoReady for the latest open cycles, application requirements, and deadlines. InfoReady is the canonical source for institutional internal-program information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coordinate limited submissions centrally via InfoReady
rubrics_metrics.description: For opportunities with institutional submission limits, we coordinate centrally — faculty can review open cycles and requirements through InfoReady.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a sponsor limits the number of institutional proposals, follow UMD's centralized coordination process (via InfoReady) to determine eligibility and internal selection procedures before preparing an external submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use SPINPlus for comprehensive external funding searches
rubrics_metrics.description: SPINPlus (Sponsored Programs Information Network) database features information on over 40,000 funding opportunities from more than 10,000 sponsors worldwide. SPINPlus data is obtained directly from the sponsoring agencies to ensure its accuracy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Search SPINPlus to identify external sponsor opportunities across agencies and foundations. Treat SPINPlus as a primary discovery tool because it aggregates sponsor-provided opportunity data.

rubrics_metrics.name: Access SPINPlus on-campus automatically; create a profile for off-campus access and saved searches
rubrics_metrics.description: On-Campus: You can automatically use SpinPlus from any on-campus IP address. Off-Campus: You'll need a SpinPlus profile (free and available here) to use the service off-campus. A profile also allows you to save searches to revisit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you work off-campus, create and use a free SPINPlus profile to retain full functionality (including saved searches). Ensure you sign in or access from campus IP to avoid access issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coordinate instrumentation and equipment grant efforts with RDO and core facilities
rubrics_metrics.description: For researchers needing major lab equipment or shared instrumentation, we encourage exploring targeted instrumentation funding opportunities in coordination with the Research Development Office (RDO) and core facilities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Engage RDO and relevant core facility staff early when pursuing equipment grants to align needs, justify shared use, and ensure accurate budgeting and institutional support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subscribe to Research Development Newsletter to stay updated on major calls and deadlines
rubrics_metrics.description: For major calls, foundation announcements, and deadlines — be sure to check our Research Development Newsletter. Sign up.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Regularly monitor or subscribe to the newsletter to receive timely alerts about high-priority funding opportunities and institutional guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consult listed federal and foundation resources for targeted sponsor information
rubrics_metrics.description: Relevant Links include Foundation Directory Online, Department of Energy (DOE), Department of Education, Department of Justice (DOJ), Grants.gov, Federal Business Opportunities, Federal Register, National Institutes of Health (NIH), National Science Foundation (NSF), National Endowment for the Humanities (NEH), and National Endowment for the Arts (NEA).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use these official sponsor portals and directories for authoritative program announcements, solicitations, and federal opportunity searches. Cross-check listings with SPINPlus when appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use UMD Research Development resources and guidance pages
rubrics_metrics.description: Relevant Links reference the Research Development Page and UMD Research Brief/@UMDResearch as campus resources.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Leverage UMD Research Development Office guidance pages and campus research communications for internal processes, proposal development support, and institution-specific instructions.
